bibl.title: The Great Temple in Berenike: new findings of the Berenike Temple Project.
bibl.seg: Martin Hense, The Great Temple in Berenike: new findings of the Berenike Temple Project.
Iwona Zych (ed.), Polish Archaeology in the Mediterranean. 26/2. Research on the Red Sea (Warsaw, 2017) pp. 133-145, figg.
bibl.note: A reinvestigation of the so-called Serapis temple of Berenike produced proof for the existence of undisturbed archaeology around and even inside the building.
